falseFriends.performance: Use 'απόδοση' for OEE performance, not 'performans' (English loanword)
falseFriends.economy: 'Οικονομικό' can mean both 'economic' and 'cheap' — context matters in manufacturing
falseFriends.schedule: Use 'πρόγραμμα παραγωγής' for production schedule, not 'σχέδιο' (design/plan)
falseFriends.available: Use 'διαθεσιμότητα' for machine availability; personal availability = 'ελευθερία'
falseFriends.station: Use 'σταθμός εργασίας' for workstation; bare 'σταθμός' means transport station

grammarNotes.greekAlphabet: Uses Greek alphabet; Latin characters for international technical terms like OEE, KPI, MTBF
grammarNotes.caseSystem: 4 cases (nominative, genitive, accusative, vocative). 'Η διαθεσιμότητα' (nom.) vs 'της διαθεσιμότητας' (gen.).
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: Three genders: 'η διαθεσιμότητα' (f), 'ο σταθμός' (m), 'το εργοστάσιο' (n). Adjectives must agree.
grammarNotes.monotonicScript: Modern Greek uses monotonic (single accent). Never polytonic (classical).
grammarNotes.compoundTermsAsPhrases: Greek terms are multi-word: 'χρόνος διακοπής' (downtime), 'προγραμματισμένος χρόνος' (planned time).
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In compound noun phrases with genitive modifiers, only the HEAD noun pluralizes. The genitive modifier stays SINGULAR. CORRECT: 'αιτίες απώλειας ταχύτητας' (causes [nom.pl] + loss [gen.sg] + speed [gen.sg]). WRONG: 'αιτίες απωλειών ταχύτητας' (causes + losses [gen.pl] + speed). The modifier 'απώλειας' names the concept of speed loss; only the head noun 'αιτίες' counts items.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE (Latin acronym) is the standard in Greek manufacturing. ΣΑΕ is NOT used in practice. ΟΕΕ (Greek letters) conflicts with Greek Economic Chamber.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, metals, cement, shipping equipment, renewable energy

commonMistakes: Using ΣΑΕ instead of OEE — ΣΑΕ is not used in Greek manufacturing practice
Using ΟΕΕ (Greek letters) which conflicts with Οικονομικό Επιμελητήριο Ελλάδας
Gender agreement errors: 'ο διαθεσιμότητα' (wrong) vs 'η διαθεσιμότητα' (correct)
Mixing monotonic and polytonic accent marks

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'αιτίες απωλειών ταχύτητας' (WRONG — 'απωλειών' is genitive plural) instead of 'αιτίες απώλειας ταχύτητας' (CORRECT — 'απώλειας' is genitive singular). The modifier names the category; only the head noun takes plural
notes: OEE (Latin) is standard in Greek manufacturing; ΣΑΕ not used, ΟΕΕ conflicts with Economic Chamber. Formal εσείς. Greek alphabet but Latin technical acronyms preserved. P95 expansion 2.00x.
